seriesStmt.title: RIDE - A review journal for digital editions and resources

body.p: RIDE is an open access review journal dedicated to digital editions and resources. RIDE aims to direct attention to digital editions and to provide a forum in which expert peers criticise and discuss the efforts of digital editors in order to improve current practices and advance future developments. It does so by asking its reviewers to pay attention not only to the traditional virtues and vices of any edition, but also to the progressing methodology and its technical implications. Read more about RIDE in our editorial.

div.head: Forthcoming issues
div.p: If you are interested in contributing a review, please contact the editors beforehand. We maintain a list of suggested projects we would like to see reviews of, but we are also happy to consider your suggestions. Please contact the editors in either case before beginning to work on your review.

div.head: Team
div.p: RIDE is published by the Institute for Documentology and Scholarly Editing (IDE). Details about the editorial board and the technical realisation can be found on our team page.
